input: Switch to a SIM card for Europe travel

gold.taskTitle: Switch to a SIM Card for Europe Travel
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to set up a SIM card solution for mobile connectivity while traveling in Europe.

questions.title: Which countries in Europe will you be visiting?
questions.description: Identify the specific countries to determine coverage needs.

questions.title: What are your departure and return dates?
questions.description: Understand the travel window to choose an appropriate plan duration.

questions.title: What is your current phone carrier and country?
questions.description: Determine whether an international add-on from the existing carrier is an option.

questions.title: Is your phone unlocked and compatible with European networks?
questions.description: Check if the device supports GSM and European frequency bands.

questions.title: How much data do you expect to use per day?
questions.description: Estimate data needs to select the right plan size.

questions.title: Do you need to keep your current phone number active?
questions.description: Determine whether calls or texts to the existing number must still come through.

questions.title: What is your budget for the SIM or data plan?
questions.description: Set a price range to filter suitable SIM card options.
